blocks.prompt: 7. A poster must have \(200\text{ cm}^{2}\) printed area with margins of 2 cm on top/bottom and 3 cm on sides. Find poster dimensions to minimize paper used.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh minimum ka sawal hai: kam se kam kaghaz, yani poster ka kul area sab se kam.
Diya kya hai? Chhapa hua (printed) hissa 200 cm² ka hai; upar aur neeche 2 cm, aur dono sides par 3 cm khali margin.
Find kya karna hai? Poster ki chaurai aur oonchai.
Rule kaunsa? Printed area wali shart se aik variable hatana, phir derivative tests.
Plan: printed hissa \(x\) by \(y\); poster \((x + 6)\) by \((y + 4)\); \(xy = 200\) se aik variable.
steps:
Diya gaya: printed area \(200\text{ cm}^{2}\); upar neeche 2 cm, har side par 3 cm margin.
Maloom karna: poster ki chaurai aur oonchai jin se kaghaz sab se kam lage.
Tareeqa: kaghaz ka area printed chaurai \(x\) ka function; \(P'(x) = 0\) aur second derivative test.

Variables aur constraint
Printed hissa \(x\) cm chaura aur \(y\) cm ooncha.
\[xy = 200 \Rightarrow y = \dfrac{200}{x}, \quad x > 0 \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: printed area fixed hai; yahi shart do variables ko jorti hai. Figure mein andar wala dashed rectangle printed hissa hai aur bahar wala poora kaghaz. Margins wali khali jagah bhi kaghaz hi hai, is liye woh bhi ginni hai.

Kaghaz ka area
Poster ki chaurai \(= x + 3 + 3 = x + 6\); oonchai \(= y + 2 + 2 = y + 4\).
\[P = (x + 6)\left(\dfrac{200}{x} + 4\right)\]
\[P = 224 + 4x + \dfrac{1200}{x} \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: margin dono taraf hota hai, is liye side margin do dafa (3 + 3) aur upar neeche wala bhi do dafa (2 + 2). Brackets kholne par \(200 + 4x + \frac{1200}{x} + 24\) bana.
Dhyan dein: sirf aik taraf ka margin jorna (jaise \(x + 3\)) aam ghalti hai.

Critical point
\[\dfrac{dP}{dx} = 4 - \dfrac{1200}{x^{2}} \quad \text{...(3)}\]
\[x^{2} = 300 \Rightarrow x = 10\sqrt{3} \approx 17.32\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1200}{x} = 1200x^{-1}\) ka derivative \(-1200x^{-2}\). Negative root chhor diya kyun ke chaurai positive hoti hai. \(\sqrt{300} = \sqrt{100 \times 3} = 10\sqrt{3}\).

Second derivative test
\[\dfrac{d^{2}P}{dx^{2}} = \dfrac{2400}{x^{3}} > 0 \ \text{ jab } x = 10\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: positive hai, is liye \(x = 10\sqrt{3}\) par kaghaz ka area minimum hai.

Dimensions
\[y = \dfrac{200}{10\sqrt{3}} = \dfrac{20\sqrt{3}}{3} \approx 11.55\]
\[\text{Width} = 6 + 10\sqrt{3} \approx 23.32\text{ cm}\]
\[\text{Height} = 4 + \dfrac{20\sqrt{3}}{3} \approx 15.55\text{ cm}\]
Kyun: (1) se \(y\) nikala (denominator ko rationalise kiya: \(\frac{20}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{20\sqrt{3}}{3}\)), phir margins jore. Sawal poster ki dimensions maangta hai, sirf printed hisse ki nahi.

Kam se kam kaghaz aur tasdeeq
\[P = 224 + 40\sqrt{3} + 40\sqrt{3}\]
\[P = 224 + 80\sqrt{3} \approx 362.56\text{ cm}^{2}\]
Tasdeeq: \(23.3205 \times 15.5470 \approx 362.56\) ✓. Aik dilchasp baat: printed hisse ki sides ka ratio \(x : y = 3 : 2\) hai, bilkul side margin aur upar wale margin ke ratio jaisa.
blocks.final_answer: Poster ki chaurai \(6 + 10\sqrt{3} \approx 23.32\) cm aur oonchai \(4 + \frac{20\sqrt{3}}{3} \approx 15.55\) cm (printed hissa \(10\sqrt{3} \times \frac{20\sqrt{3}}{3}\) cm); kam se kam kaghaz \(224 + 80\sqrt{3} \approx 362.56\text{ cm}^{2}\).

answer_figure.alt: Poster sahi naap ke saath: printed hissa 10 root 3, takreeban 17.32 cm, by 20 root 3 by 3, takreeban 11.55 cm, kaghaz ke andar hai; upar aur neeche 2 cm aur dono sides par 3 cm margin. Kaghaz takreeban 23.32 cm chaura aur 15.55 cm ooncha hai.
